verdict.rationale: Windmill provides a documented CLI (wmill) for deploying and syncing from Git, supports webhooks/schedules/API triggers for headless execution, and can self-host via Docker/Kubernetes for CI pipelines — all strongly supporting headless/CI automation use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on CI-pipeline examples or third-party corroboration of the CLI/webhook flow working seamlessly in a CI system beyond vendor docs.
